steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ summary; prepared-state plans must start here.

Open the RFQ stage of the live project.
Reach the Responses tab specified by the case.
Open Extend Submission Time, choose the 15-minute preset, save it, and verify the end time moved 15 minutes after the prior end.
Verify the expected confirmation toast after the time extension.
